faq.sub_lead: Quick answers for new Boulder City homeowners. For anything else, call or text

items.question: When is the best time to tint a new home?
items.answer: As soon as you take possession, ideally before you move in. An empty home is the fastest, cleanest install and the film protects your new flooring and furnishings from the very first day of sun.

items.question: Can you finish film and blinds before move-in?
items.answer: Yes. Coordinate with us around your closing or walkthrough date and we can have film and blinds handled before the moving truck arrives.

items.question: Do you serve Liberty Ridge, Iron Pointe and Boulder Hills Estates?
items.answer: Yes. We are the local Boulder City shop and we cover all of Boulder City, Henderson and Southern Nevada.

items.question: Does window film really protect new floors and furniture?
items.answer: Yes. The window film industry ties meaningful fade protection to films that block up to 99 percent of UV rays, which is what our ceramic films do, helping keep new flooring, cabinets and furnishings from fading in the desert sun.

items.question: Can you protect the new car in the driveway too?
items.answer: Absolutely. New homes usually mean new vehicles. We add auto tint, ceramic coating and clear bra so your car is protected the same week as your windows.
